business_definition: Top-level record structure containing customer information
Customer identifier code (PIC X(10))
Customer name or business entity name (PIC X(30))
Customer classification type (PIC X(10))
Customer account status code (PIC X(8))
Customer tax rate as decimal fraction (PIC 9V999)
Customer previous account balance in dollars and cents (PIC 9(7)V99)
Top-level record structure containing usage information
Customer identifier for usage record (PIC X(10))
Quantity of units consumed during billing period (PIC 9(7))
Billing month in YYYYMM format (PIC X(6))
Complete invoice record output buffer (PIC X(180))
Working storage variable for current customer identifier being processed (PIC X(10))
Working storage variable for current billing month in YYYYMM format (PIC X(6))
Working storage variable for usage units quantity (PIC 9(7)) (VALUE ZERO)
Working storage variable for billing rate per unit (PIC 9V99) (VALUE ZERO)
Working storage variable for calculated usage charge amount (PIC 9(9)V99) (VALUE ZERO)
Working storage variable for discount amount applied (PIC 9(9)V99) (VALUE ZERO)
Working storage variable for amount subject to taxation (PIC 9(9)V99) (VALUE ZERO)
Working storage variable for calculated tax amount (PIC 9(9)V99) (VALUE ZERO)
Working storage variable for final invoice total amount (PIC 9(9)V99) (VALUE ZERO)
Working storage variable for minimum billing charge threshold (PIC 9(5)V99) (VALUE 25)
